info.title: FaceMatch
info.description: Self-hosted face detection, face matching and attendance API. Send images as multipart/form-data. Authenticate with the `X-API-Key` header (or `Authorization: Bearer <key>`).

servers.description: Local server. Change it to yours, e.g. https://face.example.com

get.description:
Liveness/readiness probe: also checks that the database answers.

**Permission:** none (public).

Prometheus metrics. Needs a key with the `metrics` scope when auth is on.

**Permission:** an API key with the `metrics` scope (or the admin key).

Service identification for humans and load balancers.

**Permission:** none (public).

post.description:
Find faces in an image (no identity lookup).

**Permission:** an API key with the `recognize` scope (or the admin key).

Find faces and identify enrolled people. Does not record anything.

**Permission:** an API key with the `recognize` scope (or the admin key).

**Permission:** an API key with the `enroll` scope (or the admin key).

Add more photos to an existing person to improve recognition.

put.description:
Replace all photos of a person (e.g. new school-year photos).

All-or-nothing: if none of the new photos is usable, the current photos are kept.

**Permission:** an API key with the `enroll` scope (or the admin key).

post.description:
Recognise everyone in the frame and record attendance.

Repeat sightings within ATTENDANCE_COOLDOWN_SECONDS return `already_marked`. With liveness on,
a face that looks like a photo or screen returns `liveness_failed` and is not recorded.

**Permission:** an API key with the `attendance` scope (or the admin key).

get.description:
Raw attendance events, newest first.

**Permission:** an API key with the `read` scope (or the admin key).

One row per person for the day: first seen (check-in), last seen (check-out).

**Permission:** an API key with the `read` scope (or the admin key).

All API keys, active and revoked. Tokens are never returned.

**Permission:** an API key with the `admin` scope (or the admin key).

post.description:
Create a scoped API key, e.g. `{"name": "gate-1", "scopes": ["attendance"]}` for a kiosk.

The token is returned only once.

**Permission:** an API key with the `admin` scope (or the admin key).

delete.description:
Revoke a key immediately.

**Permission:** an API key with the `admin` scope (or the admin key).

get.description:
Webhook delivery queue, newest first. Failed deliveries can be retried.

**Permission:** an API key with the `admin` scope (or the admin key).

parameters.name: status

schema.description: Only this status: pending, delivered or failed.
schema.title: Status

parameters.description: Only this status: pending, delivered or failed.

post.description:
Send a failed webhook delivery again.

**Permission:** an API key with the `admin` scope (or the admin key).

get.description:
Which key this is and what it may do (useful to check a kiosk or integration key).

**Permission:** any valid API key.

Who changed what: enrollments, photo changes, deletions, keys, webhook retries. Newest first.

**Permission:** an API key with the `admin` scope (or the admin key).

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: First characters of the token, to recognise it.

token.title: Token
token.description: Shown only once. Store it securely.

box.description: Bounding box in original image pixels.

landmarks.title: Landmarks
landmarks.description: Right eye, left eye, nose tip, right mouth corner, left mouth corner.

match.description: Null when the face is unknown.

unknown_reason.title: Unknown Reason
unknown_reason.description: Why match is null: face too small, closest person below MATCH_THRESHOLD, two people too close to call (MATCH_MARGIN), or nobody enrolled.

closest.description: /recognize only, for testing and tuning: the nearest enrolled person when match is null. Never returned by /attendance, so kiosks don't reveal near-misses.

liveness_score.title: Liveness Score
liveness_score.description: Probability that the face is live (not a photo or screen). Set on /attendance when liveness is on, and on /recognize with ?liveness=true.

timestamp.title: Timestamp
timestamp.description: New event time, or the earlier event when already_marked.
